definitions.explanation: The last imperial dynasty of China, founded by the Manchus, which ruled from 1644 until the revolution of 1911–12.

examples.japanese: {清|しん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皇帝|こうてい}→皇帝：15856_koutei⟧
examples.english: the last emperor of the Qing

examples.japanese: {日清戦争|にっしんせんそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{清|しん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧だった。
examples.english: The Sino-Japanese War of 1894–95 was a war between Japan and Qing China.

examples.japanese: {清|しん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{満州|まんしゅう}{族|ぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皇帝|こうてい}→皇帝：15856_koutei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧⟦{全土|ぜんど}→全土：12063_zendo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支配|しはい}していた→支配する：25222_shihaisuru⟧。
examples.english: In the Qing period, Manchu emperors ruled all of China.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日清戦争|にっしんせんそう}: the First Sino-Japanese War (1894–95)
- {清|しん}{朝|ちょう}: the Qing dynasty

WATCH OUT:
The reading しん is the dynasty; the same kanji is usually {清|せい} (⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧) or ⟦{清|きよ}い→清い：00239_kiyoi⟧.
